items.title: Micron Technology (MU) Showed A Rack Scale AI Memory Pooling Breakthrough
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) and Primemas showcased their Abaco Project collaboration on rack-scale AI memory pooling at FMS 2026. The Abaco Project uses CXL attached shared memory to pool capacity across a rack, targeting static local memory bottlenecks in AI and HPC data centers. Developed for the US Department of Energy, the project highlights Micron's role as memory partner on next generation infrastructure for scalable AI workloads.
